verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented way to assign a conversation to a teammate or to route incoming mail to a specific owner. The team features shown are adjacent: shared read statuses, reply-collision indicators, @mentions in team comments, and shared snippets. Auto Labels and Split Inbox sort incoming mail into the user's own tabs but do not route it to teammates, so they do not make ownership explicit.

support.subject: As a team-lead, I can assign conversations to teammates and route incoming mail with rules so ownership is explicit
